hints.content:
$\begin{align}
f(x)&=2 x^2 +13 x +20
\\\\
&=2 \left(x^2 +\dfrac{13}{2} x\right) +20
\end{align}$

Now we want to complete $x^2 +\dfrac{13}{2} x$ into a perfect square.

To do that, we should add $\left(\dfrac{\blueD{\frac{13}{2}}}{2}\right)^2=\goldD{\dfrac{169}{16}}$ to it:

$x^2\blueD{+\dfrac{13}{2}}x+\goldD{\dfrac{169}{16}}=\left(x +\dfrac{13}{4}\right)^2$

In conclusion, the function after completing the square is written as:

$f(x)=2 \left(x +\dfrac{13}{4}\right)^2 -\dfrac{9}{8}$
